name: Home-Style Chicken Curry
summary: Bone-in chicken thighs simmered in an onion-tomato masala, served with rice. The everyday version, not the takeout one.

ingredients.name: bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs, skin removed
chili powder (or cayenne for more heat)

instructions: Pull the skin off the thighs (it comes away easily) and season the chicken with salt.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the bay leaf and onion and cook 10 minutes until deep golden.
Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the cumin, coriander, turmeric, and chili for 30 seconds.
Add the crushed tomatoes and cook 5 minutes until thick and the oil starts to separate.

Add the chicken and 250 mL water. Cover and simmer 30–35 minutes, turning once, until the meat pulls off the bone. Meanwhile, cook the rice: 300 g rice with 600 mL water, simmered covered for 15 minutes, then rested 5 minutes.
Stir in the garam masala, season with salt, and serve over the rice.

glutenFree.notes: Chicken, tomatoes, rice, and spices are naturally gluten-free. Check the garam masala label for added flour.

budgetNotes: Bone-in thighs at $8.82/kg are half the price of boneless and give a better gravy. Pull the meat off the bones before serving if you prefer.
Removing the skin keeps the curry from going greasy. Crisp the skins in a dry pan for a cook's snack.
A spoon of plain yogurt stirred in at the end makes it creamier.
